name: Uninstaller
description: Remove an app and the files it leaves behind, after you review them. Goes to the Trash.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Removes an app together with the files it leaves around your Mac, after you've seen the list.
rules: Pick an app, review the leftover files it found, and move them to the Trash.
Apps that come with macOS and Zephydian itself can't be removed here.
